Question B-001-016-007.

Why the correct answer is right: Single sideband is prohibited in the 10.100 MHz to 10.150 MHz band.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "18.068 MHz to 18.168 MHz": 18.068 MHz to 18.168 MHz is not the band where the bank prohibits SSB.
- sourceIndex 2: "24.890 MHz to 24.990 MHz": 24.890 MHz to 24.990 MHz is not the official SSB-prohibited range.
- sourceIndex 3: "7.000 MHz to 7.300 MHz": 7.000 MHz to 7.300 MHz is not the choice with the SSB prohibition in this question.
